localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description:
This picnic shelter rental comes with two covered shelters, water tap, one large firepit, two small barbecues, and one large barbecue.
PLEASE NOTE: If your group is conducting special activities other than simple gatherings (i.e. special set up like canopies, amplified music, professional filming/photography, using a drone, commercial/business use, serving alcohol, and or having vendors like food trucks/caterers), you MUST contact the Park at paige.pike@parks.wa.gov or call 360-899-7203 regarding a special activity permit at least 60 days in advance of your event. Failure to do so or groups exceeding maximum occupancy can result in the cancellation of your event.

localizedValues.name: Heron Center
localizedValues.description:
Interior capacity over 140 people; combined with the covered patio and surrounding grounds, capacity of 300.
The magnificent log cabin architecture of the BP Heron Center offers beautiful views of Birch Bay and is an ideal location for small to large gatherings. The building has its own restroom, a countertop with sink and microwave, and includes an audio system and video projector with screen. It comes with foldable tables and chairs for events. Shelter must be vacated no later than dusk. Parking is abundant but is shared with the general public so plan to arrive early. Carpooling is always encouraged. Discover passes are required for each vehicle.
PLEASE NOTE: If your group is conducting special activities other than simple gatherings (i.e. special set up like canopies, amplified music, professional filming/photography, using a drone, commercial/business use, serving alcohol, and or having vendors like food trucks/caterers), you MUST contact the Park at paige.pike@parks.wa.gov or call 360-899-7203 regarding a special activity permit at least 60 days in advance of your event. Failure to do so or groups exceeding maximum occupancy can result in the cancellation of your event.
